Best Racing Games for Android Marshmallow

Racing games are always more interesting that anything else. There are different types of racing games. For example, you can play bike racing, car racing and many more. On Android, you can find all those two kind of games. But, car racing is more popular for Android.

If you have a good CPU, GPU and battery, why don’t you try some racing games? Today, we are about to create a list of top 5 racing games for Android Marshmallow, which is currently running on most of the mobile. Not only Marshmallow, but also you can play these games on other versions of Android. But, please note that you must have a good storage, CPU and GPU. Otherwise, some games may not run on your mobile.

Best Racing Games for Android Marshmallow

Although, there are so many racing games for Android, but here is a list of top games only. Do check this out.

Asphalt Nitro

If you have ever played Need For Speed Shift or Hot Pursuit, you will just Asphalt Nitro as both are quite same. Although, this game has been developed by Gameloft, yet, the context is quite same. You can find different tracks, cars and many more. Based on the points, this would be also possible to change sphere parts of cars. Asphalt Nitro is available for Android 4.0 and later version and this is comparatively low in size – only 24MB. (Download)

Asphalt 8 Airborne

This is something awesome as Asphalt 8 Airborne is available for only high end Android mobiles. Although, it is available for Android 2.3, yet, you cannot play until or unless you have a good CPU. Your game will get interrupted many times during the gameplay if you have low storage, CPU or RAM. However, if you can play this game, you will experience how the best games are made. There are some luxury cars like Lamborghini Veneno, Bugatti Veyron, Ferrari FXX and Pagani Zonda R, Lamborghini Aventador and Audi R8 LMS Ultra and many more. (Download)

Real Racing 3

This is something good by Electronic Arts aka EA Sports. Real Racing 3 is consisted with some awesome cars, tracks and players. Obviously, you can be a player of Real Racing 3 by just entering the race. The most important thing is this racing game is you can race with other players over the internet. This is also possible to race anonymously. The real race begins when 22 high end card meet on one track. This is the climax of Real Racing 3. You can change the track to practice, you can also change the car to test different things. (Download)

Need For Speed Most Wanted

If you have played the PC version, you know how good it is. The cars, tracks, moves, handling etc. are just awesome in the PC version. The almost same thing is also available for Android. You can play Need for Speed Most Wanted on Android 2.3 and later mobiles. This is small in size and it is awesome in terms of gameplay, graphics etc. You can get around 40 super cars in this game along with some awesome tracks. At the same time, this is also possible to change sphere parts of any car but you will need points or credits. (Download)

Need For Speed No Limits

This is another awesome racing game for Android and you can download it on Android 4.0.3 and later version. The main difference between Most Wanted and No Limits is graphics and internal gameplay. You can certainly find difference between handling, cars and tracks. Although, this is not bad but it could have better than Most Wanted. However, in this game, you can find various tracks, cars indeed those can be modified according to your wish. (Download)
